title: PENKO
support_msg: Penko is a free, open-source language adventure. Your support helps us continue to add features.
welcome_msg: Choose your experience mode. Standard Mode is free, private, and runs entirely on your device using procedural logic. Cloud Mode uses Google AI for dynamic storytelling.
mode_offline_desc: Free, Private, Procedural. No AI Key needed.
mode_local_desc: Runs in Browser (CPU). Universal compatibility. ~800MB DL.
mode_ollama_desc: Connect to localhost:11434. Best for Linux/Firefox.
mode_openai_desc: Connect to LM Studio / LocalAI (OpenAI Compatible).
mode_cloud_desc: Advanced AI, Infinite Story. Requires Key.
security_note: Key is stored in your browser session only. It is deleted when you close this tab.
download_warning_msg: Browser AI Mode requires downloading ~800MB of model data to your browser cache. This happens only once. Runs on CPU (Universal).
ollama_help_msg: Ensure Ollama is running. You MUST set 'OLLAMA_ORIGINS="*"' in your environment variables to allow browser access.
openai_help_msg: Connect to any OpenAI-compatible local server. Default is LM Studio port.
ws_note: * Downloaded files will be reviewed by maintainers before release.
loading_model_cache: Your selected AI model is being cached to your browser storage.
loading_model_cache_dynamic: The AI model (~{size}) is being cached to your browser storage.
loading_once: This happens only once. Future sessions will load instantly.
lc_clear_cache_hint: Click "Clear Cache" if models aren't updating or you're having issues
lc_download_voice: Download voice features if you want text-to-speech or speech-to-text
lc_confirm_clear_title: ⚠️ This will clear ALL cached data including:
lc_confirm_clear_items:
• AI models (text-generation, TTS, STT)
• Model registry (will re-fetch from Hugging Face)
• Translation cache
• IndexedDB data
lc_confirm_clear_recommended:
💡 Recommended for:
  - First-time users (start fresh)
  - After major updates
  - When experiencing issues
lc_confirm_clear_warning: You MUST refresh the page after clearing!
ws_dash_msg: Help us reach 100% coverage for {LANG}. Contributing creates a richer experience for everyone.
install_browser_restriction: Seu navegador restringe a instalação automática.
install_firefox_hint: Procure o ícone na sua barra de endereços.
install_safari_hint: Toque em Compartilhar e role até "Adicionar à Tela Inicial".
save_imported: Cartucho de Salvamento Importado! Clique em 'Continuar'.
content_creation_desc: Crie suas próprias aventuras na Oficina
cartridge_selected: Cartucho selecionado! Clique em "IA do Navegador" para começar.
create_first_pack: Crie seu primeiro pacote na Oficina!
upload_custom_pack: Envie um pacote personalizado para começar
